name: Fran (2012 Games)

origin.summary: An event from the 2012 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: The classic 21-15-9 thruster-and-pull-up couplet, reused directly as a Games event under its original name.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2012/7 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-10; the classic Girl WOD Fran, reused as a Games event; contested by the top 12 athletes overall
